pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The neck and shoulder regions feature large, tessellated, dark-colored polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients. As the pattern progresses toward the posterior flank, the patches decrease in spatial area and transition into more sub-circular, rounded geometries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a geometric grid. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-junctions. The pixel thickness of these corridors remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank, with subtle narrowing in the densely packed posterior clusters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder displays a jagged, high-frequency sawtooth profile with low amplitude relative to the neck width.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three avian organisms (likely Buphagus spp.) clinging to the pelage: one on the lower neck/shoulder boundary, one on the lower mid-flank, and one on the upper dorsal ridge near the shoulder.
